I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the next renewal for Brackenwater Freight Co. is 25 November. Ilse posted that in the same channel on 14 October, and nobody in the channel has changed it since.

Marcus is a member of #north-team, so reading that channel on his behalf was fine. A renewal date counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it can go to anyone on the account's team. I also told him I couldn't find a Brackenwater contract or account file he can see to check the date against, so Ilse's message is the only source I have.
